sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for the page
sections.what: Brings in the signed-in user helper, the not-found helper, the contest data function, two icons and the link component.
sections.why: Needed so the page can load data, draw icons and link to other pages.

sections.name: MatchLeaderboardPage (part 1)
sections.title: Loading the match and building the team rows
sections.what: Reads the crew and match ids, finds the signed-in user, loads the match and its entries (a missing result leads to a Not Found page), and attaches each owner's name to their team. It also draws the Match Center heading, a back arrow to the crew, and the match status badge.
sections.why: Likely reason: the server loads everything before drawing, so the page does not need a loading state.
sections.watch_out: If contestEntries stops returning owner names or points, the rows will show blanks or zeros.

sections.name: MatchLeaderboardPage (part 2)
sections.title: Team rows and captain details
sections.what: Draws each team row with its rank number, owner's name, player count and points. Once the match is completed, shows the captain and vice captain names under the team.
sections.why: Likely reason: captain picks are hidden until the match ends, and a waiting note shows before scores post.
sections.watch_out: The 2x and 1.5x labels are fixed text, so update them if the multipliers change.

summary: Shows the points table for one match in a crew, listing each member's submitted team with its total points.
purpose: Lets crew members compare how their picked teams scored in a match.
why: Likely reason: the page is built on the server so the scores arrive with the page and no extra request is needed.
how: Reads the crew and match ids from the address, finds the signed-in user, loads the match and its submitted entries, then lists each team with its owner, player count and total points. After the match is completed, the captain and vice captain are shown under each team.
inputs: The crew id and match id from the address, the signed-in user, and the match and entry data from contestEntries.
outputs: A page with the match title, a status badge, and a numbered list of teams with points. Shows a waiting note for upcoming matches and an empty message when no teams exist.
risks: The captain (2x) and vice captain (1.5x) labels are fixed text, so they will be wrong if the scoring rule changes. Points are shown to one decimal place.
debug: If the page says Not Found, check the result of contestEntries. If the list is empty, check whether teams were submitted for this crew and match. If scores are wrong, check totalPoints in the service, not this file.
